title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Patao Primary School in the Barrio of Bawod, Municipality of Bantayan, Province of Cebu, to Bawod Primary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Patao Primary School in the Barrio of Bawod, Municipality of Bantayan, Province of Cebu, to Bawod Primary School

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2557_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Patao Primary School in the barrio of Bawod, Municipality of Bantayan, Province of Cebu, is changed to Bawod Primary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
